nom: Banila Co Clean It Zero Original Cleansing Balm

avis.texte: I tried this cleansing balm a couple years ago and really liked it. Since then I've tried a few others, b it always keep coming back to this one.

avis.titre: Works great for taking making off after a long day
avis.texte: Smells good, works great, lasts forever and leaves skin feeling soft.
I dont use it everyday. When i do use it, im soft and bright after.

avis.titre: Clean It Zero Original Cleansing Balm
avis.texte: I love this product, I recommend it. It removes makeup while leaving the skin very moisturized. Vitamin C and extract and leaves the skin revitalized
I have been using this product for YEARS. It's so good at removing sunscreen, concealer, and mascara. I also have sensitive skin so when I find something that works I stick to it!

avis.titre: This is the best cleansing balm
avis.texte: I have such sensitive skin on my face that I try to stick with certain products I know won't cause irritation. I've tried so many different cleansing balms and oils. Most cause my eyelids to flare up. I'm now on my second big tub of this cleansing balm and this is the only one that is gentle enough to not cause an allergy nor make my eyes swell up.

I have repurchased the big size many times, and I've gifted this twice!! It's so gentle! I straight up rub it all over my face, eyelashes and lids included, then add water and rub then rinse. So easy. I don't have to double cleanse. It's gentle on my eyelid eczema too!

I do really like the product itself, but about 2 weeks into using it I remembered why I havent bought it in a long time. The lid collects excess product, which then liquefies, pools around the outside rim and runs down the side. Not the biggest deal, just annoying, especially for the price point.
Love this for makeup removal both am and pm. Much more reasonably priced than the clinque balm. Leaves my face feeling soft and moisturized.

avis.titre: Price wise, performance, ease… what's not to love?!
avis.texte: A cleansing balm is essential for all of us who love to wear makeup. It goes on and is washed off quickly. Am essential step that shouldn't break your budget. Try this Banila Co Cleansing balm. Rinse well. May need a washcloth to gently remove from eyes. Best balm!!

avis.titre: First time cleansing balm user and I won't go back!
avis.texte: I've never used a cleansing balm before, but I decided to because makeup wipes don't really remove my makeup. This cleansing balm removed all my makeup without irritation. I have very dry and sensitive skin. When I rinsed it off, my skin felt clean and moisturized.

I've been using this balm for a few years. It works great. You don't need to use a whole lot of product. I have rosaeca and it doesn't cause me to flare up. The only con is it does make my vision blurry when I use in my eye area no matter how tightly I keep my eyes closed and how thoroughly I rinse it off

This cleansing balm works great to remove face makeup, but not mascara. It also gets in your eyes and makes your vision blurry for a while after use, no matter how hard you try to not get it in your eyes
Ive been using this balm for a few years now. I tried some other brans but they cannit compare to how good this product is!

I have been using this product consistently for the last two weeks and there's been a major difference in my skin! I switched from makeup wipes to a cleansing balm and I won't look back. My skin is smoother, less red, and I don't have to worry about the tugging and pulling the wipes are doing to my skin. This gives me a solid first cleanse to remove my makeup so I can follow up with my regular face cleanser. I feel as though using this, my face cleanser can perform much more efficiently.
You only need very little. Safe for eyes. Super affordable! On my third tub.

Since I started doing my makeup almost daily, makeup removing wipes and cotton pads with micellar water started to irritate my dry skin, but this balm is so soft and easy to use, I especially love that I can use it on my eyes! Easiest repurchase!

I have very sensitive skin and eyes, and this isnonenof the fre products i sweae by to get my makeuo completly off! It even takes off my trad goth makeup with ease. I have purchased this product at least 8 times so far.
Leaves skin soft. Removes waterproof makeup with ease. Works the same as higher priced cleansing balms.

avis.titre: This has become a staple in my skincare routine
avis.texte: I love the feel when applying it. You don't have to use as much as you might think. The way it lathers up yet is so moisturizing is top notch! This has become a staple in my skincare routine. The large one for home use and the 3.3 oz for my on the go bag.
I love this cleansing balm! Takes off all makeup, even waterproof, and leaves my sensitive skin feeling smooth.

This was my first ever balm and it always worked well so I've repurchased multiple times. I saw a different Korean brand balm went on sale when I was running low of this one, so I bought it. Immediately upon using the other balm I realized how much better this one is. This thing CLEANS. You really dont need much of this one at all, just take a nickel sized amount for your entire face. It actually melts eye makeup so fast and with little friction needed on your part. This is an important reason I'll never try anything else again, I don't want to give myself more wrinkles. This one also emulsifies properly and you have time to work it in before you wash away. 10/10

avis.titre: Easy to follow instructions; Caution with eyes!
avis.texte: I sometimes wear makeup when I go to formal events. I wear a lot of foundation and eye shadow along with some mascara. On my first use, I was able to melt off my foundation cleanly off only I didn't really like the texture of the oil that's left behind. For my eyes, it had trouble with removing the eye shadows and mascara which should have warned me about its potential effects on my eye. The next morning, my eyelids look swollen, which I had forgot may have been cause by the oils inside the balm clogging the thin skin area. For next time, I may go for another cleanser around my eyes but this cleaning balm was really good and smells lovely. I managed to get 4-5 uses out of the small container but it was also due to the weird "oily feeling" left behind which I did not like so I used more product than recommended. It does mean it was bad, rather I am unused to cleansing balms as opposed to using miicellar cleansing water. If you want an eye makeup remover I would not recommend this.
I use this as the first step in a double-cleanse to remove my sunscreen and mascara, and it works great. The character limit on these reviews is absurd, though. I'm almost out of space. What a waste.

I had high hopes for this product with all the great reviews, however when I tried it not only did it irritate my sensitive skin (it tingled/red/burned) it also didn't clean right .Unfortunately I cannot use this and would not recommend with anyone with sensitive skin.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way!
avis.texte: I picked this up during the Black Friday Sale and I am very impressed. I use about a quarter size amount, and it takes care of all of my makeup. I love how clean my skin feels after use too!

So, i usually dont use foundation/makeup because I've yet to find stuff that won't break me out. I still use sunscreen daily, though. This stuff won't remove my sunscreen as easily as i would like. I currently use the man:yo one and that one feels like it really removes what it needs to, however im on the hunt for a cleanser where 'a little goes a long way'. Using 3 pumps a day really adds up! For Clean it Zero: Maybe i didn't use as much as i should've, but i felt as though i was using way too much for just sunscreen and still not getting the cleanse i wanted/needed. I always follow up my first cleanser with the gentle cleanser from La Roche Posay to help rid of any of leftover spf or cleanser. My skin wasn't feeling free of product. I doubt i'll keep this until i try it with a makeup day.

I have VERY acne prone skin. I love this stuff because it really cleans my makeup off before I go in with my acne cleanser. I've had no irritation or breakouts from it, and love that the ingredients are doing more than just removing my makeup. I wear waterproof mascara and do my whole face with one scoop, then go in with a second small scoop to really get my mascara off. works great and doesn't make my eyes all blurry like other balms do. also, I didn't realize it until opening my second jar, but keep that little plastic thingy that your spatula comes packaged in! i thought it was just packaging and tossed it when I opened my first jar. its made to fit perfectly inside the jar and keep your spatula separate. it may sound silly to some, but I didn't know it so I just wanted to throw that out there for others who also may not!
I originally had a smaller one to try and I fell in love with how well this works at removing my waterproof liquid eyeliner.

This used to be a great product when it was the "Tri-Acid Peel" instead of the now "Tea Tree Ex". I did email the company to confirm they did change the formula. After its been change its a more oily consistency and residue left on my face, breaks me out and makes my skin feel tight, and a strong smell. I wish they would have just created the "Tea Tree Ex" to be a separate product i do not recommend now.

avis.titre: Good at removing makeup, leaves eyes cloudy
avis.texte: Ive used this for a few nights and have liked it so far. Removes makeup well and leaves skin soft Didnt take off tubing mascara well and left my eyes cloudy cause it kind of got in them and lasted for like 5 minutes. But like what it does to skin.
This make up remover is so gentle and silky. It leaves my skin feeling so clean and fresh and gets off all the make up.

This is my first cleansing balm, but I love it so far! It leaves my skin super smooth, easy way to remove makeup without rubbing and it's very gentle on my sensitive skin. Like it A LOT more than the Clinique cleansing oil. Haven't tested with heavy makeup.

If you've never tried this cleansing balm — do it! It melts everything off, even waterproof mascara, without drying or stripping my skin. It's so satisfying to use, and my face feels baby-soft after. I've tried a lot of cleansers, but this one is unmatched. A total must-have in my nightly routine.

With other cleansing balms, I can feel it taking off my makeup and cleaning my face. With this, I didn't feel clean at all. It felt like I was just putting something waxy on my skin that didn't do anything.
This is by far the best cleansing balm ever. Melts all makeup, even waterproof mascara, and wipes away effortlessly.

I've been using the Banila Co Clean It Zero Cleansing Balm gifted by Banila Co and I'm so impressed. The texture feels like creamy at first, then melts into an oil that takes off all my makeup and sunscreen even the stubborn waterproof stuff. After rinsing, my skin feels really clean but still soft and hydrated, not stripped of natural oils like I've felt with other products. I like that it has Vitamin E and other nourishing ingredients, and the jar lasts a long time so it's a good value! The scent is sweet and smells good so it doesn't bother me. I always follow up with a gentle cleanser, and this has definitely earned a permanent spot in my routine.

I've used the another of these and loved it. Made the mistake of going to another brand to try out and ended up coming right back. I love the way it removes make up and cleanses my face without breaking me out.

soft and smooth texture that feels gentle on the skin. A little goes a long way, making the price very fair for the amount of product you get. Most importantly, it removes all makeup effectively—even long-wear foundation and mascara—leaving the skin clean without feeling stripped.

avis.titre: Leaves my skin fresh and perfectly clean!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this cleansing balm! It melts away makeup and sunscreen effortlessly, even waterproof products, without stripping my skin. The texture is smooth and lightweight, and it rinses off without leaving any residue. I've noticed my pores look clearer and my skin feels refreshed after every use. Perfect for my sensitive skin, and I really enjoy the gentle formula. This has become a must-have in my nighttime routine I would definitely repurchase!
I used this before with no issues but this time I woke up with swollen blurry eyes and a rash all over my face.

I am a fan of this cleansing balm. It is super effective removing all traces of makeup (including waterproof mascara). I also like that it is affordable. It's very convenient if you travel because it's a balm and not a liquid formula. I continue to repurchase it because it's great and at a reasonable price.

avis.titre: My skin is clean, not dried out
avis.texte: I have always used a cleanser and an oily eye makeup remover to take my makeup off. As my skin matures, this has been leaving me dry and my under eye skin irritated. Since I've started using this cleansing balm my skin is clean not dry.

i think the tirle says everything. its an okay oil cleanser/first cleanser, but its nothing to write home about. its literally just okay. you can find much better products for this price. very disappointed in this.
Even with light use, finding it hard to remove entirely. Causes irritation and watering throughout the day.

avis.titre: Not a fan of the formula change
avis.texte: I really liked the old formula better. It was much better at treating my acne than this new one. The old one practically eliminated my acne single handedly but the new one does next to nothing to treat it. Relying on tea tree oil as the star ingredient is a weird, very outdated choice. Having multiple types of acid was absolutely the more effective formula. I don't know why making the new formula vegan meant that they needed to remove the tri-peel acid angle.

I have used some other balms for my first cleanse and always come back to this one. Doesn't aggravated my dry eyes, oily or sensitive skin. Removes all sunscreen and makeup. Scent is very soft to me. Love this!
I love that this balm works effortlessly. It removes all my waterproof makeup and doesnt burn my eyes. I will continue purchasing this product!

love banila co and banila co clearly loves me back. I believe I got this travel size free with a purchase but I knew their quality beforehand and was not let down. it breaks down the makeup like it owes money. left feeling fresh and clean. so glad I got into kpop and got introduced to this product family. [guys try the primer. it'll change your life.]

I bought this for a trip that I will wear water resistant tinted sunscreen and tested it a few times before the trip. It does not work very good and it takes a lot of balm and rubbing to breakdown this type of sunscreen or waterproof mascara. I had to double Zero balm cleanse and then a 3rd foaming cleanser cleanse. This whole process may be too irritating for some skin types. I suspect it is good for light to medium make up.

So i bought one of these cleansing balms a few weeks ago, after using a liquid oil cleanser for a while. This is so nice, the scent is present but not overpowering or irritating, it feels nice and soft, and once you start massaging it in, it blends out easily. Once you add water, it emulsifies instantly and rinses off with very little effort. After cleansing, i feel clean and soft, not stripped in the slightest. And after a few weeks I definitely see a difference in my pores and acne. I loved this enough that I went out and bought a backup if the larger size so i have one ready to go when my current jar runs out

I was given this product in exchange for my honest review. Banila Co's Clean It Zero Cleansing Balm melts off makeup (even waterproof!) in one easy step—no dryness, no residue. It's gentle, hydrating, and packed with skin-loving ingredients—free of parabens, sulfates, and artificial colors. My sensitive skin loves it, and now I get the hype. Total must-have!

I was given this product in exchange for my honest review. Clean It Zero is a game-changer! It effortlessly melts away all my makeup, even stubborn waterproof mascara, leaving my skin feeling clean and soft. A skincare essential!

(I was given this product in exchange for my honest review) I remember when double cleansing became a craze and so many came on the market... none compare to Banila & Co! It breaks down my sunscreen and makeup with ease and doesn't blur/burn my eyes. The original formula unclogs my pores and helps fight against breakouts due to lack of cleansing!
My favorite makeup remover. It only takes a small amount and it takes everything off and makes my skin so soft. Love that there are several formulas.

The balm boasts a soft, sorbet-like consistency that melts into a silky oil upon contact with the skin. It efficiently dissolves makeup, sunscreen, and daily impurities without causing irritation. Users have reported that it rinses off cleanly without leaving a greasy residue, making it suitable for various skin types, including sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Leaves my skin soft and clean
avis.texte: This is probably my current favorite cleansing balm. It leaves my skin soft and hydrated but also cleans well and takes off all makeup. I have used it alone and with a foaming gel cleanser afterwards. I think I still prefer to double cleanse with this instead of using it alone because when I used it alone I got some acne afterwards.
Smells great, first time using this one, always had the pink one but this one is great

I was given this product in exchange for my honest review. I was skeptical, especially since I've tried other brands, but this is my new go-to cleansing product! I love how soft and clean it leaves my skin feeling. Easy to apply and cleanse. A must beauty product for me!

avis.titre: A Cleansing Balm That Just Gets It Right
avis.texte: This balm is a go-to in my double cleanse routine. It breaks down makeup and SPF in seconds—no tugging, no stinging, no residue. The texture is buttery smooth and feels way more luxe than the price point. What I love most? It rinses off clean, leaves my skin soft (not stripped), and keeps my routine simple but effective. No heavy fragrance, no irritation—just a solid, reliable first cleanse. Perfect for travel or everyday use. It just works.

l absolutely love the this Cleansing Balm. It melts away all my makeup so easily-even waterproof mascara-without irritating my skin. The texture is super smooth and turns into a silky oil when applied. It leaves my face feeling clean, soft, and hydrated, not tight or greasy. l also really like the fresh scent and how convenient the packaging is. This has become a staple in my skincare routine, and l'll definitely keep repurchasing.

The Clean It Zero Cleansing Balm Original is my new favorite for removing makeup. It gently and effortlessly melts away all my makeup, even waterproof mascara, without any harsh rubbing. It leaves my skin feeling soft, refreshed and clean afterwards. It doesnt stripped or dry out my skin like other cleansing balm. I enjoy that it rinses away completely with no greasy residue left behind. This balm is a quick, effective, and gentle way to cleanse, leaving my skin pampered every time. I was given this product in exchange for my honest review.

I have tried the avocado version of this and love it and the original was no exception! I am obsessed with how hydrated it leaves my skin without making it greasy. I have extremely dry, sensitive skin and this does not irritate it at all. 10/10 would recommend. I was given this product in exchange for my honest review.

This is by far the best cleansing balm i have tried! It completely melts off my makeup as well as waterproof mascara and it doesn't irritate my eyes! I was given this product in exchange for my honest review.

avis.titre: Effortlessly removes heavy makeup, including waterproo
avis.texte: Ideal For: Users wearing moderate to full makeup, including waterproof products, who appreciate a satisfying balm-to-oil cleanse. Also suitable for sensitive/normal skin types. Best Used: As step one in a double-cleanse routine—massage on dry skin, emulsify with water, rinse, then follow with a gentle foaming cleanser.

avis.titre: The balm I never thought I needed!
avis.texte: I was given this product in exchange for my honest review. I never used this type of makeup remover before it went on smooth and melted all my makeup away leaving my skin feeling hydrated and smooth. I loved the fact that it was simple to use, smooth on your face then wash off with warm water. I will definitely be recommending to a friend and continue using.
So great for combo to oily skin. Using an oil cleanser to remove make-up, sweat or just the day from your skin is a great way to keep pores clean.
Really good cleanser that removes all of my makeup easily and is very gentle on the skin. Perfect if you have sensitive skin! I was given this product in exchange for my honest review.
Ive tried mutiple metling balms for makeup removal and this is the first one that actually works for me. A little does go a long way. Doesnt break me out and leaves my skin smooth!

avis.titre: My Newest Go To Hydrating Makeup Remover
avis.texte: Thanks to Banila Co for sending me this product. My review is based on my honest experience. This Banila Co Clean It Zero Cleansing Balm is my newest go to for removing my waterproof makeup. They include an applicator to make it easier to apply, which is nice. I love that's it's super gentle but crazy effective at removing makeup on my sensitive skin. It also leaves my skin feeling clean, soft, and extra hydrated right after I use it. Highly recommend trying it out for yourself!

I was given this product in exchange for my honest review. This product does take off your make up easily. It has a bit of a strong scent that isn't for everyone. The only thing i don't like is my face feels greasy after i use it.

avis.titre: THE BEST CLEANSING CREAM IN THE WORLD
avis.texte: It turns out that I have dry skin with acne tendency almost which is very rare, and I was very afraid to use cream products, however this cleanser is very delicate with my skin and leaves it the hydration it needs removing all traces of makeup or dirt. I've been using it for a week now and it's wonderful.

I was given this product in exchange for my honest review. I have been using this product for the last week and it's honestly amazing at removing my sunscreen I use daily! I have super combination to dry acne prone skin and I prefer products that are deeply hydrating to prevent stripping my skin of its oils. This product also removed my waterproof makeup and did not leave my skin blurry like other makeup removers do! I honestly recommend this to anyone looking for a reliable makeup remover that will leave your skin feeling hydrated!

When it comes to cleansing, I take it seriously — because for me, removing makeup and SPF thoroughly is a must. When I first tried this cleansing balm, I completely fell in love. Until then, I had only used oils — so imagine my surprise when I realized how convenient and comfortable cleansing with a balm can be! First, the texture: in the jar, it's like butter. But once it touches your hands, it melts into a silky sherbet-like texture that's incredibly pleasant to use. Unlike oils, it doesn't run through your fingers — making it perfect for facial massage and gentle makeup removal. It's also travel-friendly thanks to its consistency — no spills, no mess. Second, effective cleansing is everything to me, and this balm truly delivers. My skin feels deeply clean, soft, and calm afterward. And third — the ingredients. It's packed with antioxidants and vitamin C that start caring for your skin from the very first step. I'm absolutely obsessed with this product. It's a cleansing game-changer.

I absolutely love this cleansing balm ! I know for sure it does remove every last bit of my makeup off but it also makes my skin feel so silky smooth and hydrated after . Love it !! I was given this product in exchange for my honest review.

I've been looking for other methods to remove my makeup ever since I learned about the long term effects of using makeup wipes. I decided to try out this cleansing balm and I loved it. It removed my makeup very easily and I love that it didn't make my face feel oily. I also really appreciate that it's filled with product to the very top so I feel like I'm getting my money's worth ◡̈

avis.titre: Double cleansing is the way to go!
avis.texte: I was given this product in exchange for my honest review. I love how this is a balm that turns into an oil. It is the first step to removing makeup and starting my cleansing routine. It's tough enough to work on some of my waterproof and long wearing makeup products. It is non irritating and does not take a lot of rubbing or scrubbing to get my make up product off. Don't need to use much because as the heat from your hands helps to emulsify, it makes it easy to use. I love there is no greasy layer of product once I wash it off. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Removes makeup and leaves my skin glowing
avis.texte: I was given this product in exchange for my honest review. I have oily, acne-prone skin, and finding a makeup remover that deeply cleans without clogging pores has been a challenge. From the first use, I was impressed. This balm melts into a silky oil that instantly breaks down waterproof makeup and sunscreen without needing to scrub. It rinses off easily, doesn't blur my eyes, and leaves my skin clean, soft, and surprisingly hydrated—with no greasy residue. The texture feels luxurious, the scent is light and pleasant, and the packaging is sleek. I genuinely look forward to using it every night. One of the best I've tried.

I was given this product in exchange for my honest review. I loved this balm so much. It took off all my makeup so easily and left my skin clean without feeling too dry. I loved the texture and the spatula that it came with!

avis.titre: Melts Makeup Off Without Irritating My Skin
avis.texte: I've used this cleansing balm more than four times now, and I can honestly say it's made my night routine so much easier. It effortlessly melts away all my makeup even that stubborn mascara residue and long-wear SPF without needing to scrub (which is so good for us sensitive skin girlies). The texture is smooth and luxurious, and it rinses off cleanly without leaving my eyes blurry, which is a big deal for me! What I love most is how soft and hydrated my skin feels immediately after using it. There's no dryness or tightness, just clean, calm skin. And even with repeated use, I haven't had any irritation or breakouts on my acne prone skin. If you're looking for a cleansing balm that actually works and feels good on your skin, this one delivers. I was given this product in exchange for my honest review.

avis.titre: Melt Away the Day with Zero Effort
avis.texte: I was given this product in exchange for my honest review and it has quickly become my go to for taking off the day without stripping your skin. It starts as a silky balm and melts into an oil that dissolves makeup, sunscreen, and buildup in seconds. Even longwear foundation and mascara don't stand a chance, and it rinses off clean without leaving a greasy film. The texture is soft and buttery, and it makes the first step of your routine feel more like a treat than a chore. It's gentle enough for sensitive skin, and it doesn't leave your face feeling tight or dry afterward. If you want an effortless, effective cleanse that feels luxurious every time, this balm is a staple worth keeping on your shelf.

I absolutely love this product because I actually bought it to remove my makeup, but aside from that, it leaves my face hydrated and incredibly soft. It removes waterproof makeup; that's great. I highly recommend it; you'll love it.

I was given this product in exchange for my honest review. I love this cleansing bomb it isn't messy at all. I dont need to use a lot of product either. I love how easy it is to use and the results it completely cleans my face.

I was given this product in exchange for my honest review. First of all, I loved the packaging. The product is a good size and comes with efficient tools for use. It comes with instructions and is very easy to open. I like that it is for all skin types. It has a pleasant, mild scent, its texture is light, and when you apply it to your skin, you can see the glow. After rinsing it off with water, you can feel the oil gone, and you get a very fresh, minty-scented feeling. I liked it. Thanks to Banila Co for sending me this product. My review is based on my honest experience.

avis.titre: Easy One Step Product in Removing Makeup and Oil
avis.texte: This product was gifted to me by Banila Co, but my review is based on my honest review of their product after several uses. I was pleased with the 'Clean It Zero Cleansing Balm'. It was easy to apply and spread on my skin, and went on smoothly. It easily removed all of my makeup and waterproof mascara! I was very happy to find it did not leave me with any blurry vision after using it to remove my eye makeup, as I typically run into with cleansing balms. I greatly appreciate this as a contact lens wearer! It left my skin feeling clean and hydrated after each use and not dry, greasy, or left with any residue afterwards. I absolutely recommend this product!

I'm obsessed with the Banila Co Clean It Zero Original Cleansing Balm. I've tried so many makeup removers over the years, but nothing compares to this. The texture is like a buttery sorbet that melts instantly into the skin.

avis.titre: Amazing at removing makeup especially mascara
avis.texte: I was given this product in exchange for my honest review and let me tell you I am definitely buying this once I finish this one. I love the size because it's big enough to get multiple uses out of it. The texture is nice and smooth and hydrates my face. I hate when makeup remover dries out my skin but this one doesn't. This is amazing at removing mascara which is the hardest thing for me to remove.

*I was given this product in exchange for my honest review. The packaging is really well made — sturdy, stylish, and feels high-quality in your hands. I also love that it comes with a little spatula, which makes it feel more hygienic and thoughtful. The balm itself has the perfect texture: firm in the jar, but as soon as it touches your fingers, it melts into a silky oil that glides effortlessly over the skin. It removes makeup beautifully — even eye makeup — without stinging or irritation. One of my favorite things is how easily it rinses off. No greasy film, no extra effort — just clean, soft skin that feels fresh and smooth. And the scent? Light, delicate, and super pleasant — it makes the whole routine feel calming and luxurious. This has quickly become my go-to cleansing balm. Everything about it just works.

Thanks to Banila Co for sending me this product. My review is based on my honest experience. I really enjoyed using this cleansing balm. It removed all of my makeup easily, was easy on the eyes (not irritating or blurry), and helped my skin problems. At first it was very oily melting everything away quickly. But after emulsifying with water it rinsed off easily. It left no residue but my skin wasn't feeling overly stripped. I used it without moisturizing afterwards accidentally (late night needed bed) and woke up with completely moisturized skin. I was amazed because I have very dry and flaky skin. I even noticed that the pores on my nose is less congested (yay for a smoother base!). I would use this as a cleanser without makeup.

My first time using a K Beauty product and actual cleansing balm… thoroughly impressed! This cleansing balm is dermatologist tested, vegan, and great for all skin types! It is also safe to use around eye area. I used the balm to get rid of impurities (sweat + SPF), and it was GREAT at getting the job done! After gym workouts, you really get that deep hydration to your skin immediately after use (felt plump and healthy). The spatula allowed for easy access and application. When scooping out the balm, I noticed it had a solid but smooth balm-like consistency. It felt like an oil when applied, which felt really good on my skin. After, I had a new layer of fresh skin! Not a fan of strong smelling products, this balm's original fresh smell was perfect! No burning/tingling sensation before or after use was greatly appreciated as well! Definitely be using this product over and over! (Thanks to Banila Co for sending me this product; however, my review is based on my honest experience.)

avis.titre: The only thing left on my skin..... Moisture
avis.texte: I was gifted this Cleansing balm by Banila Co after repeated use I was not disappointed. This bomb literally melted away my makeup every time.
